newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-WELSH TRY BURST SHATTERS SCOTLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELSH TRY BURST SHATTERS SCOTLAND.

text.p: One of the most devastating bursts of scoring in Five Nations history earned Wales a 34-19 victory over Scotland on Saturday in a bizarre international at Murrayfield.
The Welsh scored three converted tries in five minutes between the 51st and 56th minutes to transform a 16-10 deficit into a 31-16 advantage and ensure their first away win over the Scots since 1985.
Scotland had led 13-10 at half-time but were blown away by opportunist tries from Neil Jenkins, Arwel Thomas and Ieuan Evans, two of them owing more than a little to the luck of the bounce.
Jenkins finished with a total of 19 points, becoming only the fifth player in history to pass 500 points in test rugby.
